nodes.label: Binary-boundary acceptance tests
nodes.rationale: Test user-visible behavior at the executable boundary.

nodes.label: Shared application services
nodes.rationale: Keep domain and application logic independent of rendering and subprocess mechanics so CLI and TUI share behavior.

nodes.label: Single-context vocabulary and architectural decisions
nodes.rationale: CONTEXT.md owns domain vocabulary and docs/adr owns decisions; proposals must flag conflicts with existing ADRs.

nodes.label: Wayfinding map, child tickets and dependency frontier
nodes.norm_label: wayfinding map, child tickets and dependency frontier
nodes.rationale: Claim the first open unassigned unblocked child; resolve with an answer and context pointer back to the map.

nodes.label: Simulated standalone worktree cleanup
nodes.rationale: Clean/dirty fixtures retain branches but do not define full production eligibility, commit reachability or force semantics.

nodes.label: Planned worktree reciprocal ownership and retained-ref reachability
nodes.norm_label: planned worktree reciprocal ownership and retained-ref reachability
nodes.rationale: Use native Git removal with no recursive fallback; detached commits require proof of reachability from retained shared refs and force cannot waive locks or ownership.

nodes.label: Standalone native Git worktree services (not started)
nodes.norm_label: standalone native git worktree services (not started)
nodes.rationale: Host-independent commands, not declarations; ensure does not recreate worktrees and removal always retains branches.

nodes.label: Agreed future Herdr active-tab initialization
nodes.rationale: Initialize browsing from each workspace active tab rather than its first tab; other HTML interactions remain exploratory.

nodes.label: Exploratory grouped checkout/worktree destinations and layout requests
nodes.norm_label: exploratory grouped checkout/worktree destinations and layout requests
nodes.rationale: Keep concrete paths visible and associate workspace/agent observations per path; layout requests do not settle existing-tab merge/replace behavior.

nodes.label: Exploratory independent workspace and worktree cleanup
nodes.norm_label: exploratory independent workspace and worktree cleanup
nodes.rationale: Closing a mock workspace does not change Git safety facts; no action implies deleting a branch.

nodes.label: Exploratory workspace cursor vs explicit host focus
nodes.norm_label: exploratory workspace cursor vs explicit host focus
nodes.rationale: Only Open/Enter changes simulated host focus; per-workspace browsing cursors and reopen behavior remain proposals beyond agreed active-tab initialization.

nodes.label: Forklift (2.0 direction only)
nodes.rationale: A navigation/working-context view built on inventory and worktree services, not a duplicate management implementation or prescribed lifecycle.

nodes.label: helm.herdr rewrite and research reference
nodes.rationale: Research at a61a9fb2432de9615ce75ddd6f2b44bee9cb4663 must be refreshed before implementation; parity is not frozen.

nodes.label: Independent workspace, worktree and branch operations
nodes.norm_label: independent workspace, worktree and branch operations
nodes.rationale: Separate Lager repository operations, Git metadata and terminal-host session/focus ownership; workspace closure is not worktree or branch deletion.

nodes.label: Typed host adapter boundary (planned)
nodes.rationale: Host topology and action execution stay behind a typed adapter; do not leak transport details or impose Herdr topology on every future host.

nodes.label: Native Git and shell process boundary
nodes.norm_label: native git and shell process boundary
nodes.rationale: Native programs retain transport, credentials, prompts and output rather than reimplementing their terminal behavior.

nodes.label: Explicit non-TTY choices
nodes.rationale: Reject missing automation choices before prompts or effects; inventory requires TTY stdin and stdout.

nodes.label: Native OS/shell signal ownership; no universal cleanup guarantee
nodes.norm_label: native os/shell signal ownership; no universal cleanup guarantee
nodes.rationale: No custom PID signal forwarding or library signal policy; external termination can bypass child-result observation and cleanup.

nodes.label: Observed native child cancellation (SIGINT or status 130)
nodes.norm_label: observed native child cancellation (sigint or status 130)
nodes.rationale: Stop later targets without rolling back completed disk/config effects; an interrupted clone is not registered or hooked.

nodes.label: Sticky inventory session failure status
nodes.rationale: Successful refresh does not erase an earlier operational failure; deliberate cancellation and informational exclusions are not failures.

nodes.label: Concrete local checkout
nodes.rationale: Disk state is observed separately from desired declarations; Git owns clone transport and native interaction.

nodes.label: Normalized repository identity
nodes.rationale: Compare host and path for duplicates, destinations and origins without losing the stored clone URL transport or text.

nodes.label: Bounded force for disclosed local-state losses
nodes.norm_label: bounded force for disclosed local-state losses
nodes.rationale: Force accepts dirty/untracked/ignored/stash/detached/unpushed warnings but never bypasses structural safety guards.

nodes.label: Dependent worktree metadata deletion guard
nodes.rationale: Live, external, locked, stale, malformed or unreadable worktree metadata blocks primary deletion; Lager does not repair or prune it.

nodes.label: Exact selected checkout revalidation
nodes.rationale: A vanished selection fails without substituting another clone of the same origin or unregistering it.

nodes.label: Non-forceable checkout ownership and path guards
nodes.norm_label: non-forceable checkout ownership and path guards
nodes.rationale: Fail closed for invalid ownership, origin, shape, symlink or root boundaries; revalidate before deletion.

nodes.label: add: create local checkouts
nodes.rationale: Per-target cloning preserves successful effects rather than promising all-or-nothing disk transactions.

nodes.label: Terminal-safe human presentation
nodes.rationale: Escape control characters and backslashes only for human display; never reconstruct operational values from labels.

nodes.label: Exact candidate mapping in fzf
nodes.rationale: Hidden row IDs preserve original paths and distinguish duplicate labels rather than parsing display text.

nodes.label: remove: guarded permanent checkout deletion
nodes.rationale: Force accepts local-state warnings, never ownership, origin, path or dependency violations.

nodes.label: Credential-free transport-preserving references
nodes.rationale: Reject credentials, queries and fragments before any effects without echoing secrets; preserve accepted clone URL text independently of identity.

nodes.label: Unknown TOML key preservation
nodes.rationale: Warn once per unknown key per command on stderr and preserve data through mutations without contaminating JSON.

nodes.label: Portable desired repository declarations
nodes.rationale: Desired repository membership remains independent from checkout existence, allowing configuration to travel between machines.

nodes.label: Disk-success-before-configuration cleanup
nodes.rationale: Failed, declined or partial deletion preserves declarations; successful deletion or verified absence permits explicit unregister behavior.

nodes.label: All-matching wildcard exclusions and restoration
nodes.rationale: Overlapping patterns use pattern-relative exclusions; register restores all matches and unregister excludes all matches atomically with explicit declarations.

nodes.label: Explicit declaration precedence and hooks
nodes.rationale: Only explicit declarations have hooks; expansion follows declaration order, exclusions, explicit precedence and deduplication.

nodes.label: Provider-backed wildcard declaration
nodes.rationale: Trailing /* is a remote membership rule, not a filesystem glob; offline list retains the rule rather than inventing concrete missing entries.

nodes.label: ensure: reconcile missing effective declarations
nodes.rationale: Create missing checkouts sequentially without pulling or resetting existing repositories.

nodes.label: hook: rerun explicit post-clone hooks
nodes.rationale: Trusted commands are executable configuration; discovery must not run repository code.

nodes.label: register: atomic declaration batch
nodes.rationale: Gather all choices before one atomic config update; invalid input or cancellation leaves original configuration unchanged.

nodes.label: unregister: remove declarations or exclude wildcard members
nodes.norm_label: unregister: remove declarations or exclude wildcard members
nodes.rationale: Changes desired membership without deleting local files.

nodes.label: AtomicRegistrationStore / registry::register_batch
nodes.rationale: All-or-nothing API corresponds to atomic CLI registration while register_many deliberately retains legacy incremental writes.

nodes.label: Ratatui and Crossterm TUI architecture requirement
nodes.norm_label: ratatui and crossterm tui architecture requirement

nodes.label: 1.0 inventory specification (partial; offline baseline implemented)
nodes.rationale: Collection-management interface; broader mutation and remote features remain unimplemented despite the offline baseline.

nodes.label: Planned inventory mutation batches and stale confirmations
nodes.norm_label: planned inventory mutation batches and stale confirmations
nodes.rationale: Freeze exact targets; continue per-target failures; shared-identity unregister waits for all selected removals and cannot be authorized by stale confirmation.

nodes.label: Mode-specific configurable inventory bindings (specification)
nodes.rationale: Validate mode-local collisions and reachable routes; invalid refreshed key maps preserve the previous valid map while reporting failure.

nodes.label: Planned inventory remote discovery (not started)
nodes.rationale: Keep local navigation usable during bounded provider requests; explicit remote refresh/retry and source generations prevent stale results from retargeting operations.

nodes.label: Unverified responsiveness acceptance targets
nodes.rationale: Measure release builds with 100/1000 repositories, at least 20 startup runs and 100 input events; p95 startup <=250ms and cached input <=50ms are targets, not results.

nodes.label: inventory / inv: read-only offline terminal overview
nodes.norm_label: inventory / inv: read-only offline terminal overview
nodes.rationale: No providers, mutations or config writes; keep exact-path duplicate origins and honest pending, error and stale observations.

nodes.label: Human acceptance and Linux validation outstanding
nodes.norm_label: human acceptance and linux validation outstanding
nodes.rationale: Historical hardening evidence is macOS ARM64 only; it does not prove Linux behavior or completion of all 1.0 surfaces.

nodes.label: Isolated HOME/config and disposable Git acceptance fixtures
nodes.norm_label: isolated home/config and disposable git acceptance fixtures
nodes.rationale: Protect real repositories and credentials; build with the normal toolchain HOME and isolate only runtime execution.

nodes.label: Opt-in archived repository discovery
nodes.rationale: Exclude archived repositories by default; list requires remote mode for archive inclusion.

nodes.label: Configuration selection and validation boundary
nodes.rationale: Explicit --config overrides LAGER_CONFIG, then HOME default; invalid semantic usage is checked before configuration loading.

nodes.label: Provider credentials via environment references
nodes.rationale: Persist environment-variable names rather than token or password values; authentication modes must be complete combinations.

nodes.label: Legacy registry::register_many incremental behavior
nodes.rationale: Earlier writes survive a later ordinary failure; do not imply all registration APIs are atomic.

nodes.label: Portable HOME-relative TOML
nodes.rationale: Never persist expanded absolute machine paths or secrets; roots resolve from HOME, not cwd.

nodes.label: Symlink-aware atomic configuration store
nodes.rationale: Resolve the target, serialize mutations with a cache lock, atomically replace it preserving permissions and logical links; refuse dangling-link init.

nodes.label: Concrete repository states: missing, cloned, conflict, unreadable
nodes.norm_label: concrete repository states: missing, cloned, conflict, unreadable

nodes.label: Partial provider success
nodes.rationale: Retain successful selections despite another provider failure but return operational failure status.

nodes.label: GitLab discovery fixture (prototype-only, not shipped provider)
nodes.norm_label: gitlab discovery fixture (prototype-only, not shipped provider)
nodes.rationale: The mock uses GitLab simulated requests while product provider support is GitHub and Bitbucket; do not infer production GitLab support.

nodes.label: Simulated inventory table and remote provider requests
nodes.norm_label: simulated inventory table and remote provider requests
nodes.rationale: Illustrates registration/checkout separation with memory-only actions; not current production behavior or implementation approval.

nodes.label: Illustrative list-as-inventory alias (conflicts with current CLI)
nodes.norm_label: illustrative list-as-inventory alias (conflicts with current cli)
nodes.rationale: Prototype alias text is not authoritative: current CLI documents list/ls separately from inventory/inv.

nodes.label: Planned separate worktree list JSON schema
nodes.norm_label: planned separate worktree list json schema
nodes.rationale: Report primary and external worktrees with partial inspection errors; do not merge this schema with declaration list JSON.

nodes.label: list / ls: offline declaration and local-state report
nodes.norm_label: list / ls: offline declaration and local-state report
nodes.rationale: A stable non-interactive report remains separate from the inventory terminal interface.

nodes.label: List JSON schema version 1
nodes.rationale: Exactly one JSON document on stdout; diagnostics on stderr and original values retained without human presentation escaping.

nodes.norm_label: lager declarative local git repository manager

nodes.label: Checksummed, provenance-attested release archives
nodes.rationale: Publish exactly four platform archives with SHA256SUMS and provenance; retry uploads with clobber.

nodes.label: Four verified macOS/Linux release builds
nodes.rationale: Verify tag, Cargo version, executable version, architecture and Linux static linkage before packaging.

nodes.norm_label: startremoval: prototype batch guard and target snapshot

nodes.norm_label: github discovery: gh authentication and github.com host

nodes.label: Wildcard expansion: provider, API URL, credentials and archived preference
nodes.norm_label: wildcard expansion: provider, api url, credentials and archived preference
nodes.rationale: Explicit repository commands do not require provider access.

nodes.label: lager add creates checkout; --register preserves declaration
nodes.norm_label: lager add creates checkout; --register preserves declaration

nodes.label: lager init: portable root and optional GitHub provider
nodes.norm_label: lager init: portable root and optional github provider
nodes.rationale: Writes ~/repos portably to $HOME/.config/lager/config.toml without overwriting an existing configuration. Nonterminal use requires explicit root, creation and GitHub choices.

nodes.label: lager list compares declarations with disk offline
nodes.norm_label: lager list compares declarations with disk offline

nodes.label: Post-clone hook: registration and /bin/sh -c execution
nodes.rationale: A post-clone command implies registration and runs only after a fresh clone, from the repository directory with normal output streams.

nodes.label: Lager issue #16 and children: delivery requirements and acceptance criteria
nodes.norm_label: lager issue #16 and children: delivery requirements and acceptance criteria

nodes.label: Inventory layout and menus: simulated design prototype, not shipped Rust behavior
nodes.norm_label: inventory layout and menus: simulated design prototype, not shipped rust behavior
nodes.rationale: Local review aid with no Git commands, network requests or file changes; issue #16 owns the feature contract and delivery requirements.

nodes.label: Destination conflict protection
nodes.rationale: Lager will not overwrite a non-matching directory or Git origin; inspect list state and choose another declaration or root.

nodes.label: Force removal retains ownership and shape checks
nodes.norm_label: force removal retains ownership and shape checks
nodes.rationale: Force acknowledges state warnings but does not bypass root, symlink, repository-shape or origin checks.

nodes.label: list --json machine-output contract
nodes.rationale: Human summaries and native Git/hook streams are intentionally separate from the JSON contract.

nodes.label: lager ensure reconciles missing effective declarations
nodes.norm_label: lager ensure reconciles missing effective declarations
nodes.rationale: Creates missing effective declarations in configuration order; repeated execution leaves matching checkouts alone.

nodes.label: Proposed inventory action menu and submenus
nodes.norm_label: proposed inventory action menu and submenus
nodes.rationale: Keep row, query and marks visible behind a bordered popup; expose every application action, with Cancel initially focused for destructive confirmation.

nodes.label: Proposed non-transactional batch disk/config outcomes
nodes.rationale: Only one mutation batch at a time. Report separate disk/config successes, failures and unattempted targets; cancellation preserves completed work. Combined removal unregisters an identity only after all its selected removals succeed; config failure does not roll back deletion.

nodes.label: Proposed 80 x 24 compact table with on-demand inspection
nodes.norm_label: proposed 80 x 24 compact table with on-demand inspection
nodes.rationale: No permanent detail pane; move path/origin to Inspect and Copy so status columns remain readable. Long popups scroll internally and full paths wrap.

nodes.label: Proposed guarded removal confirmation and stale-target rejection
nodes.norm_label: proposed guarded removal confirmation and stale-target rejection
nodes.rationale: Show every exact target, disclosed loss and hard blocker; default to Cancel with force off. Force accepts only listed losses and cannot remove blockers. Changed targets require a new preview and cannot authorize deletion or unregister.

nodes.label: Planned inventory keybinding TOML preservation and API compatibility
nodes.norm_label: planned inventory keybinding toml preservation and api compatibility
nodes.rationale: Parse inventory settings without breaking the public repository-config API; preserve keybinding tables through every repository config mutation and test byte-preservation through registration.

nodes.label: Proposed local/config refresh without provider requests
nodes.norm_label: proposed local/config refresh without provider requests
nodes.rationale: Keep local/config refresh separate from remote refresh while preserving query, cursor and surviving marks.

nodes.label: Proposed mode-aware configurable inventory keybindings
nodes.rationale: Action-based maps isolate text input and permit remapping. Omitted actions retain defaults; supplied lists replace bindings. Reject collisions, unknown names and unreachable exits. Invalid refresh retains the valid map; hints/help show effective bindings.

nodes.label: Proposed native Git terminal handoff
nodes.rationale: Suspend the alternate screen so Git owns stdin/stdout/stderr and authentication; inventory shortcuts are inactive. Native Ctrl-C interrupts the child/batch and exits 130.

nodes.label: Proposed Ratatui Clear, Block and List popup composition
nodes.norm_label: proposed ratatui clear, block and list popup composition
nodes.rationale: Built-in widgets suffice for a small menu; avoid a separate popup/menu dependency. Lager supplies menu state, keyboard handling and action availability.

nodes.label: Proposed concrete reference input and exact destination preview
nodes.norm_label: proposed concrete reference input and exact destination preview
nodes.rationale: Validate without mutation; preview identity and configured destination before Register, Clone or Clone + register. Existing marks remain unrelated. Prototype validation supports only owner/repo or GitHub HTTPS, not every planned reference format.

nodes.label: Proposed independent provider discovery, caching and retries
nodes.norm_label: proposed independent provider discovery, caching and retries
nodes.rationale: Retry failed providers without discarding successes or selection; expose archived preference and stale cached results. Disabling discovery hides remote-only rows and clears their marks.

nodes.label: Proposed whole-row selection and visible/hidden marks
nodes.norm_label: proposed whole-row selection and visible/hidden marks
nodes.rationale: Mutations target marked rows or the current row when none are marked, including hidden targets; copying always uses the current row. Registration and checkout are separate columns, with meaningful no-color labels.

nodes.label: Proposed explicit pending, empty and incomplete scan states
nodes.norm_label: proposed explicit pending, empty and incomplete scan states
nodes.rationale: Pending is unknown, not clean; empty is not an error and no matches is not an empty collection. Retain local results while exposing unreadable directories and provider failures as incomplete discovery.
